name: ThreadKeep
description: Saves an agent task's goal, decisions and next action as durable checkpoints over MCP, so work can be recovered and resumed in a fresh session.

skills.name: Save Checkpoint
skills.description: Records a task's goal, decisions made so far and the next action as a durable checkpoint an agent can return to.

skills.name: Resume Task
skills.description: Restores a saved checkpoint into a fresh session so a new agent run can continue the work without losing context.

skills.name: List Plans
skills.description: Lists stored plans and checkpoints available to the caller, with public discovery kept separate from privileged writes.
